# Timeline

**Figma:** Timeline/Item, Activity, Milestones, Gantt and .Primitives/Timeline/* (page ❖ Timeline 16121:9)  
**Import:** `import { TimelineActivity, TimelineItem, TimelineMilestones, TimelineGantt } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Show what happened and what is planned: an activity history (TimelineActivity of TimelineItem rows), dated project milestones (TimelineMilestones) and a roadmap of grouped tasks across weeks (TimelineGantt). Dates are Dates or local ISO strings.

## Use it for
- A record's Activity tab, a side-panel history, notifications grouped by day: TimelineActivity.
- Project phases on an overview page, a release plan: TimelineMilestones.
- Project plans, roadmaps, campaign schedules that span weeks: TimelineGantt.

## Use something else for
- Steps the user moves through in a form → Stepper.
- A timed plan of one day → ScheduleItinerary.
- Hours of one day → CalendarTimeGrid or ScheduleResourceGrid.
- A chat thread → Chat.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size | `TimelineItem size · TimelineActivity size` | md · sm |
| Kind / Tone | `marker.kind · marker.tone` | dot · icon · avatar; neutral · accent · positive · warning · negative |
| Status | `(from today) · TimelineMilestone status` | done · current · upcoming |
| Orientation | `TimelineMilestone orientation (device)` | horizontal · vertical |
| Kind | `TimelineGanttBar kind · tasks[].kind` | task · summary · milestone |
| Level | `TimelineGanttLabel level` | group · task |
| Device | `device` | desktop · mobile; unset follows the breakpoint |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/timeline.json`.

### TimelineActivity
Figma `Timeline/Activity` (16131:1311): an activity feed — day kickers (Body/Small/Bold, Neutral/Light: "Today", "Yesterday", then the date) over `Timeline/Item` rows, kicker → items Gap/XSmall, day → day Gap/Large; each day's last item has no connector. Newest first. A list per day, named by its kicker.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entries` (required) | `TimelineEntryData[]` | — | The entries (any order): shown newest first, grouped by day. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today ("Today", "Yesterday" kickers). Default: the device clock. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"md"` | Item size: `md` (default) or `sm` (a compact log). |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (640) or `mobile` (358); the items are the same. Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the items (`{ "Item[approve]/Marker": { tone: "positive" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### TimelineItem
Figma `Timeline/Item` (16131:1090): one entry of an activity history — a 24px rail (the marker, then a 2px Border/Neutral/Subtle connector, Gap/2XSmall), then the body (Padding-top 3XSmall, Padding-bottom Large / Small, Gap/2XSmall): the actor in Body/Small/Bold and what they did in Body/Small/Regular (Strongest) beside the time (Caption/Regular Light, Gap/XSmall), an optional detail (Body/Small/Regular Base) and attachment. Gap/Small (Small: XSmall) between rail and body.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actor` | `ReactNode` | — | The actor, in Body/Small/Bold ("Maya Chen"). |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | What happened, after the actor (" approved your leave request"). |
| `time` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Time ("10:42"). |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Description + Detail: one line of detail ("Annual leave · Oct 12 – Oct 16"). |
| `attachment` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Attachment + Attachment-Slot: a comment, a file, a change. A string draws the comment box (Surface/Alt, Padding/Small, Corner-Radius/Base); pass a node for your own. |
| `connector` | `boolean` | `true` | Figma Connector: the rail down to the next item (off on a group's last item). Default true. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"md"` | Figma Size: `md` (24px marker, Large after each item, default) or `sm` (Small after; a Dot marker suits it). |
| `marker` | `TimelineMarkerData` | — | The marker (Kind = Figma Type, Tone, icon, avatar). Default: Icon Accent (Medium), Dot Neutral (Small). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the marker (`{ "Marker": { tone: "positive" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### TimelineMilestones
Figma `Timeline/Milestones` (16132:777): a row (desktop, Horizontal) or a column (phone, Vertical) of `.Primitives/Timeline/Milestone` — Done ones in Accent, exactly one Current (with its description), the rest Upcoming; the last one has no connector. A desktop box too narrow for 96px per milestone stacks them as the phone does. An ordered list; the Current milestone carries `aria-current="step"`.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `milestones` (required) | `TimelineMilestoneData[]` | — | The milestones, in date order. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today: milestones before it are Done, the first on or after it is Current, the rest Upcoming. Default: the device clock. |
| `currentId` | `string` | — | The Current milestone by id, when it is not the date's (a late phase). |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (a row; items share the width) or `mobile` (a column). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLOListElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<ol>`. |

### TimelineGantt
Figma `Timeline/Gantt` (16136:859): a Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px Pale, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped) — a 40px header ("Tasks" and the week starts, Caption/Medium Neutral/Light) over a task column of `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Label` rows (240, 128 on a phone) beside a track of 44px rows with week columns, Pale rules outside the layout. `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Bar` bars sit by date — x = days from the first column × day width + 2, width = days × day width − 4, centred in the row — and keep their real dates past the edge (the track scrolls; never squeezed). A group's Summary spans its tasks; the vertical `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` marks today. On a phone, milestone titles live in the task column only. Semantics: a `role="table"` — the week headers, then per row a row header (the label; a group's is a disclosure that hides its tasks) and one cell with its bar (a button with `onTaskClick`).

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groups` (required) | `TimelineGroupData[]` | — | The plan: groups of tasks. A group's summary bar spans its tasks. |
| `start` | `Date \| string` | — | First day of the scale (rounded to its Monday). Default: the Monday of the earliest task. |
| `weeks` | `number` | `9` | How many weeks the scale shows (default 9). |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today: the vertical now line. Default: the device clock. |
| `onTaskClick` | `(task: TimelineTaskData, target: HTMLElement) => void` | — | Pressing a task or milestone bar: open it, anchored to `target`. Without it the bars are static. |
| `defaultCollapsed` | `string[]` | `[]` | Groups collapsed at first (by id). |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (240px task column, the whole scale) or `mobile` (128px column, three weeks visible; the track scrolls and opens at today, else the plan's start). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the plan (default the locale's "Tasks"). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the labels and bars (`{ "Bar[ui]": { color: "teal" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### TimelineMarker
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Marker` (16130:55): the marker on a timeline rail, Image-Size/XSmall (24px). Dot: 10px — `Color/Background/`<Tone>`/Solid/Default`, Neutral a Surface dot with a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid ring. Icon: Dock-Icon XSmall Subtle (Neutral, Accent, Green, Orange, Red). Avatar: Avatar/Single XSmall Subtle. Decorative: the item says what happened.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"dot" \| "icon" \| "avatar"` | `"dot"` | Figma Type: `dot` (10px; Neutral is hollow), `icon` (Dock-Icon XSmall, Subtle) or `avatar` (Avatar XSmall, one initial). Avatar when a person did it, Icon when the system did, Dot in compact logs. |
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "accent" \| "positive" \| "warning" \| "negative"` | `"neutral"` | Figma Tone (status, not decoration). Default neutral. |
| `icon` | `IconName` | — | Type=Icon: the icon (default the tone's: edit, message, check, clock, flag). |
| `avatarName` | `string` | `""` | Type=Avatar: the person's name (its initial) and photo. |
| `avatarSrc` | `string` | — |  |
| `avatarTheme` | `Exclude<AvatarTheme, "photo">` | `"teal"` | Type=Avatar without a photo: the initial's theme (default teal). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the Dock-Icon / Avatar it draws (`{ "Icon": { theme: "blue" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<span>`. |

### TimelineMilestone
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Milestone` (16130:147): one dated milestone. Horizontal: an axis (a 16px marker box, then a 2px connector, Gap/2XSmall) over the content (Padding-right Small, Gap/3XSmall), Gap/XSmall. Vertical: a 16px rail (Padding-top 3XSmall) beside the content (Padding-bottom Large), Gap/Small. Date Caption/Medium (Current Accent/Base, else Neutral/Light), Title Body/Small/Medium (Current Bold) Strongest, Description Caption/Regular Light. Markers as the Itinerary's: Done Accent dot, Current a 16px Accent ring, Upcoming a hollow Neutral/Solid ring; connectors Accent after Done, Border/Neutral/Subtle otherwise.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Date ("Sep 25"). |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Title ("Design sign-off"). |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Description: one line of detail (shown on the Current milestone). |
| `status` | `"done" \| "current" \| "upcoming"` | `"upcoming"` | Figma Status: `done` (Accent dot and connector), `current` (Accent ring, Accent date, bold title) or `upcoming` (a hollow neutral dot). |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Figma Orientation: `horizontal` (marker and connector above the text; desktop) or `vertical` (the rail on the left; phones). Default horizontal. |
| `connector` | `boolean` | `true` | Figma Connector (off on the last milestone). Default true. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### TimelineGanttBar
Figma `.Primitives/Timeline/Gantt-Bar` (16130:77), 28px high. Task: Padding 2XSmall · XSmall, Corner-Radius/XSmall, `Color/Background/Support/`<Hue>`/Subtle` with a 2px `Color/Border/Support/`<Hue>`/Solid` leading rule, the title in Caption/Bold Strongest (one line). Summary: an 8px Corner-Radius/2XSmall `Color/Background/Neutral/Solid/Default` bar. Milestone: an 11px Accent/Solid square turned 45° in a 16px box, the title (Caption/Bold, Neutral/Light: Caption text is always Light) Gap/XSmall after it.

Also accepts `Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "title" | "color">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Title (inside a task, beside a milestone; a summary shows none). |
| `kind` | `"task" \| "summary" \| "milestone"` | `"task"` | Figma Kind: `task` (Subtle hue with a Solid leading rule, the title inside), `summary` (a group's span: an 8px Neutral bar) or `milestone` (an Accent diamond with the title beside it). |
| `color` | `"brand" \| "blue" \| "violet" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "orange" \| "pink"` | `"brand"` | Figma Color for tasks: the workstream (default brand). |
| `hideTitle` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide a milestone's title (the phone Gantt shows it in the task column only). |
| `onClick` | `MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Pressing the bar (open the task). Without it the bar is static. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` | — | Ref to the root element (a `<button>` when pressable, else a `<div>`). |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type AvatarTheme = "photo" | "accent" | "blue" | "brown" | "crimson" | "cyan" | "green" | "indigo" | "neutral" | "orange" | "pink" | "plum" | "purple" | "red" | "teal" | "violet" | "yellow" | "sky" | "mint" | "bronze" | "golden"
type CalendarColor = "brand" | "blue" | "violet" | "teal" | "green" | "orange" | "pink"
type CalendarDateInput = Date | string
interface TimelineEntryData { id: string; at: CalendarDateInput; actor?: string; title: string; description?: string; attachment?: ReactNode; marker?: TimelineMarkerData; }
interface TimelineGroupData { id: string; name: string; tasks: TimelineTaskData[]; }
interface TimelineMarkerData extends Pick<TimelineMarkerProps, "tone" | "icon" | "avatarName" | "avatarSrc" | "avatarTheme"> { kind?: TimelineMarkerProps["type"]; }
interface TimelineMilestoneData { id: string; date: CalendarDateInput; title: string; description?: string; }
interface TimelineTaskData { id: string; name: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end?: CalendarDateInput; kind?: "task" | "milestone"; color?: CalendarColor; assignee?: { src?: string; alt?: string }; }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the Gantt's group toggles and task bars |
| Enter / Space | A group row: show or hide its tasks; a bar: open its task |

## ✅ Do
- Use an Avatar marker when a person acted, an Icon when the system did, a Dot in compact logs.
- Let the tone carry status: Positive approved, Negative rejected, Warning waiting, Accent the newest or current.
- Name the Gantt after the plan (aria-label) so its table reads as more than "Tasks".
- Keep bars on their real dates: the track scrolls; never squeeze a bar to fit.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't colour markers for decoration: tone is status.
- Don't use Milestones or the Gantt for a form the user steps through: use Stepper.
- Don't mark more than one milestone Current.

## Accessibility
- Activity days are sections named by their kicker, each a list of items; the actor is bold text, not a heading.
- Milestones are an ordered list; the Current one carries aria-current="step".
- The Gantt is a table: week column headers, a row header per task (a group's is a disclosure button with aria-expanded) and one cell with its bar; bars are buttons with onTaskClick, named by name and dates.

## Content
- Item titles name the actor first, then the action in plain words ("Maya Chen approved your leave request").
- Dates are short (Sep 25); times 24-hour (10:42).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `timeline/gantt-names-plan` | warn | Name the Gantt after its plan (aria-label="Lotus banking redesign"): without it the table is only "Tasks", and a page with two plans reads them the same. | `zen-allow-gantt-name: <reason>` |
